title: Shareable package readiness stamp (v1)
description: Machine-readable ready | degraded | not-ready stamp with closed reason codes. Green ready requires governance + coding seat OR explicit user-accepted degraded. Zero coding seats and incomplete interactive dialogue stamp not-ready (fail closed).

status.description: Closed readiness status. Never claim ready without governance+seat or explicit degraded acceptance. not-ready = zero seats or silent path without full dialogue.

feedback_opt_in.description: Feedback consent is NOT a readiness gate; default false.
